description: This file defines middleware functions for security purposes in a Node.js/Express backend, including CORS configuration, helmet security headers, and rate limiting. It also exports these middleware functions for use in the application.

methods.name: toOriginMaybe
methods.description: Normalizes a URL-like string to an origin (scheme://host[:port]) or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: corsMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns a CORS middleware with a whitelist derived from environment variables and default origins.

methods.name: helmetMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns a Helmet middleware with relaxed Content Security Policy and cross-origin resource policy.

methods.name: rateLimiter
methods.description: Creates and returns a rate limiting middleware with configurable window, max requests, and skipping GET requests based on environment variables.
